name: West Virginia

windshield.strip: nonreflective, not red/yellow/amber; only along the top, not below the AS-1 line or more than 5 in. from the top, whichever is closer to the top

backSide.note: reflectivity max 20%; one right and one left outside mirror required

rear.note: reflectivity max 20%; dual outside mirrors required

backSide.note: light transmittance requirement does not apply to windows behind the driver on trucks, buses, trailers, motor homes and multipurpose passenger vehicles (reflectivity limit still applies)

tint.measuredHow: not explicit; light transmission defined as light passing 'through a product or material' (film), device used 'in conjunction with' safety glazing
tint.dualMirrors: One right and one left outside rear-view mirror required if any sun-screening device is used behind the driver
tint.certificateOrSticker: Manufacturer label (max 1.5 sq in.) with manufacturer name and % light transmission, permanently installed between film and glass in the lower left corner of each tinted glazing surface (viewed from outside); installing without the label is prohibited

medicalExemption.text: Affidavit signed by a physician or optometrist licensed in West Virginia stating the condition requires darker sun-screening; affidavit must be with the person (or guardian) whenever transported in the vehicle; no state permit

quotes: shall be a nonreflective type with reflectivity of not more than twenty percent and have a light transmission of not less than thirty-five percent

The side windows behind the driver and the rear most windows may have a sun-screening device ... that has a light transmission of not less than thirty-five percent and a reflectivity of not more than twenty percent.
may not extend downward beyond the ASI line or more than five inches from the top of the windshield whichever is closer to the top
The light transmittance requirement of this section does not apply to windows behind the driver on trucks, buses, trailers, mobile homes and multipurpose passenger vehicles.
Any person violating the provisions of this section is guilty of a misdemeanor and, upon conviction thereof, shall be fined not more than $200.

helmet.conditions: All operators and passengers of motorcycles and motor-driven cycles (fully enclosed autocycles exempt); eye protection also required

handheldPhone.fineText: Up to $100 first conviction, up to $200 second within 24 months, up to $350 third+; higher penalties if property damage or injury

radarDetector.note: No state ban found; commercial vehicles over 10,001 lb banned federally (49 CFR 392.71)

openQuestions: Primary enforcement of 17C-14-15 not explicitly confirmed in excerpts read (no secondary-only clause seen); section amended in 2025 session
Underglow and lift rules not located
